description: This file defines the route component for the note detail view in a Remix.run application, including loaders, actions, and the React component for editing and deleting notes.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Sets page metadata, specifically the document title, based on the note data.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches a note by ID for display, throws 404 if not found.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form actions for updating or deleting a note.

methods.name: NoteDetail
methods.description: React component rendering the note editing interface, delete button, and status indicators.

methods.name: ErrorBoundary
methods.description: Renders fallback UI when an error occurs during rendering.

methods.name: CatchBoundary
methods.description: Renders fallback UI when the note is not found (404).
